data.property_schedule_text:
ALL THAT residential flat being FLAT NO. 8, situated on the FOURTH FLOOR of the building constructed on PLOT NO. 1A, in the layout / colony known as Hauz Khas Enclave, within the revenue estate of Village Hauz Khas, in the area of New Delhi Municipal Council (NDMC), New Delhi - 110016, admeasuring approximately 1200 (One Thousand Two Hundred) square feet of super built-up area (carpet area approximately 950 square feet), together with the right to use one covered car parking space in the stilt parking area and proportionate undivided share in the land and common areas of the building.
BOUNDARIES OF THE SAID FLAT:
On the North : Common passage and Flat No. 7 of the same floor
On the South : Outer wall facing the Hauz Khas District Park
On the East : Flat No. 9 of the same floor
On the West : Staircase, lift lobby and common area
BOUNDARIES OF THE PLOT:
On the North : 20 feet wide internal road of the Enclave
On the South : Plot No. 1B, Hauz Khas Enclave
On the East : Plot No. 2, Hauz Khas Enclave
On the West : 30 feet wide main approach road
